messages:
marta: Quick heads-up — scheduling a QUIET window 2026-04-02 02:00-03:30 UTC for apac-edge pool-epsilon. Purpose: GPU driver + NIC microcode + a small thermal calibration run. We want rolling cordon/drain with backfills.
liam: SGTM. Which racks/nodes are in scope?
marta: Targeting cohort tags: region=apac-west1, pool=epsilon, rack in set [r-12, r-13, r-14]. ~120 GPUs total. Plan is 10-node cohort drains in parallel, 5min KV-cache seed per node afterwards.
anya: Any known tenant heavy hitters during that window? Looking at usage, some async batching jobs run at 02:15 UTC.
marta: We've scoped by tenant-priority = low for eviction. Ops-oncall will apply temporary throttles if we see tail latency.
ops-oncall: I'll be on call 01:45-04:00 UTC. Will watch egress queues and p99 token latencies.
sam: Cost question — will backfills use burst capacity in us-west to avoid customer impact (and do we bill against reserved commit)?
liam: Backfills will route to regional spare pools; finance said short bursts under 2h fall under buffer credit. I flagged it.
marta: Sequence: 1) cordon nodes 2) drain with `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120` 3) apply microcode 4) reboot 5) nvlink sanity 6) uncordon.
anya: Can we add a quick pre-check script to ensure KV-cache hits remain >= 75% before uncordon?
liam: Yeah, will add a probe: `curl -s https://telemetry/api/pool/epsilon/kv_hit_rate | jq .value` and require >=0.75. If not met, extend warmseed.
infra-bot: Maintenance ticket created: MW-7865 — apac-edge pool-epsilon maintenance. Incident channel #incidents notified.
ops-oncall: Noting networking: egress queue depth spikes happened last week when we drained >15 nodes simultaneously. Recommend max-parallel=10 and spread across racks.
marta: Agreed. We'll set `maxParallel=10` in the drain job and add a 2-minute sleep between cohorts.
sam: Who will handle customer comms in APAC? Product wants a short banner if any user-visible regen slowdown expected.
marta: I'll draft the banner and ping @support. If we see any p95 regressions >250ms, we'll post an update.
liam: Post-maint tasks: 1) run perf smoke (50 synthetic calls, 99th < 300ms) 2) validate embedding accuracy on model-shadow 3) reconcile capacity accounting.
anya: If thermal throttle pops during post-reboot warmup, do we have fallback plan?
marta: Fallback: move batch assignments to dedicated pool-delta and rollback microcode if repeated thrash. Ops-oncall will coordinate with capacity-swap runbook.
infra-bot: Reminder scheduled: 2026-04-02T02:00:00Z — MW-7865 will start in 18 hours.
liam: +1. I'll own the KV-cache probe and the drain job config.
ops-oncall: I'll keep an eye on egress qdepth and SLO alerts. Reach me at pager if anything spikes.
marta: Thanks all — will post final runbook and k8s job payload in this thread 1h before. :thumbsup:
